source_hypotheses.required: Published formal-group/logarithm hypotheses and split or nonsplit quaternion embedding hypotheses; every inherited arithmetic input retains its stated scope.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The same K=Q(sqrt(2)), normalized curve, unramified places with p>76176, rational coefficient basis, quaternion algebra and inherited height/pole/prime statements.
source_hypotheses.justification: The 25-application author inventory and independently read addition compare each new use. The logarithm bound is used only at depth at least one, with 1>1/(p-1); the split quadratic-algebra case is included. No new RC, height or prime theorem is asserted.

constructed_objects.required: A quadratic system defining exactly integer rational inputs, with fixed coefficients and both existential directions.
constructed_objects.constructed: The selected mixed-12/40, normalized-pole, half-trace, one-coefficient-anchor, scalar-norm, reciprocal, mixed-toric, cancellation and norm-reuse chain.
constructed_objects.justification: The section separately proves exact witness transformations and the strengthened arithmetic predicates. The final 467 residuals use 498 total variables, including the input. Alternative factored-pole/order-10 candidates are excluded.

index_domain_coverage.required: All rational solutions for soundness and a compatible construction for every integer input; all primes and indices consumed by the old arithmetic lemmas.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: Odd root labels and the same three scales; order 12 only for the input comparisons; order 40 for the remaining label and Lucas tests.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Integrality transfers before high-depth congruences. Completeness fixes labels and roots before selecting primes, incorporates the extra finite denominator exclusions, then makes compatible CRT and progression choices.

transition_maps.required: Explicit maps in each witness replacement, with retained external consumers and no division by unproved nonzero quantities.
transition_maps.constructed: Pole scalings, half-trace strengthening, anchor translation, scalar-only reciprocal map, seven-equation toric circuit, denominator cancellation and norm substitution.
transition_maps.justification: Maps, inverses where claimed, nonzero guards, and identities are in the addition. The seven-equation circuit retains both q12 and q40. dL=a*K-2Db*G uses nonzero d,a. Norm-square reuse is t^2-8u^2 with u the product, not twice the product.

limiting_object_identity.required: The arithmetic certificate must be the exact residual system and polynomial whose coefficient tables are published.
limiting_object_identity.constructed: Pinned candidate498, its sparse sum of squares, coordinate-reindexed tables and the unique 16-coordinate lift.
limiting_object_identity.justification: The finite verifier reconstructs the source and every selected stage and recomputes all residual squares. No analytic limiting object is introduced by this revision; the relevant identity is source predicate to exact polynomial.

coefficient_conventions.required: Integer coefficients, fixed C rather than a free variable, basis (1,rho), v(p)=1, and total-variable counts.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: C=3^(2^25); 498 total coordinates/497 witnesses; lift 514/513; primitive content one.
coefficient_conventions.justification: The translated anchor has maximum 16C^2. The lift starts c0=3^1024 and takes fifteen squarings, with largest coefficient 3^2048+1005072314676622. Sparse expansion, reindexing and table checks corroborate degree four and stated counts.

local_conditions.required: The actual formal place and scalar divisibility hypotheses, including possible nonformal R and half-trace completeness.
local_conditions.constructed: An admissible formal place for H; if R is near the other zero of z, [2]R is formal; five half-traces are forced nonzero at selected split primes.
local_conditions.justification: Duplication and logarithm applied to [h]([2]R)=[2s]H prove v_p(s)>=32 without assuming R formal. Asymmetric prime depths force a negative/integral conjugate pair so their sum is nonzero.

exceptional_cases.required: Zero denominators, S=+/-P, inert primes, zero/split ternary case, deleted coordinate consumers, and incompatible completeness choices must be handled.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Positive reciprocal denominator; retained inverse of f0; separate +/-P cases; split embedding convention; explicit prior-choice order.
exceptional_cases.justification: S=P is excluded by g!=0; S=-P is the actual -2P point and fails the explicit 3-adic anchor before the large-index bound is invoked. Norm reuse needs no nonzero assumption. Independent reviews check these same cases.

downstream_consumption.required: The reduced precisions and smaller anchor must still force Lucas vanishing and input integrality, and their coefficient statements must match the retained theorem labeled thm:v12-quartic for P498 and P514.
downstream_consumption.constructed: The same exponent-19 height estimate with scalar order 32, Lucas order 40, input order 12 and C=3^(2^25).
downstream_consumption.justification: The retained Version 12 section supplies numerical margins and both height contradictions, then 2X^2+3 integral implies X integral. Its simultaneous completeness construction proves the reverse direction. Historical integration checks bind these conclusions and coefficient data to the Version 12 text; the current consumer is the unchanged theorem labeled thm:v12-quartic. The Version 14 abstract concerns P299/P314 and has a separate contract.
